author: MLG_Jirafa
body:
It might sound like a crazy idea, and it needs a lot of work to do, a lot of help and oppinions are needed
The idea in the rough is like a normal nebula match (2 teams) but the monument is a big pool of water (or something related) and every player spawn with an sponge, so the idea is that the enemy team needs to empty the pool to win
Idea Nº2: kinda like the same, but with a pool in the middle and water counters (point based TDM)
Idea Nº3(I only support this idea now): 1 Pool in the back of each team where you have to bring back the sponge with water, with time limit, water counters when you place the sponge in your spawn, and when you have the sponge with water on your inventory you get a dia chestplate for 5 mins to bring it back

In my opinion the 3rd idea is the best, because a lot of people want the CTW back on the server, but it is used in other server, and this is a new and fresh idea to make that happen, idk any suggestion will be fully appreciated, I will be updating the post with all your comments and thoughts
